verses: Uss Allah kay liye tamam tareefen sazawaar hain jo (ibtida’an) aasmano aur zamin ka peda kerney wala aur do do teen teen char char paron walay farishton ko apna payghumbar (qasid) bananey wala hai, makhlooq mein jo chahaye ziyadti kerta hai Allah Taalaa yaqeenan her cheez per qadir hai
Allah Taalaa jo rehmat logon kay liye khol dey so uss ka koi band kerney wala nahi aur jiss ko band kerdey so uss kay baad uss ka koi jari kerney wala nahi aur o hi ghalib hikmat wala hai

Logo! tum per jo inam Allah Taalaa ney kiye hain unhen yaad kero. Kiya Allah kay siwa aur koi bhi khaliq hai jo tumhen aasman o zamin say rozi phonchaye? Uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi. Pus tum kahan ultay jatay ho
Aur agar yeh aap ko jhutlayen to aap say pehlay kay tamam rasool bhi jhutlaye chukay hain. Tamam kaam Allah hi ki taraf lotaye jatay hain
Logo! Allah Taalaa ka wada sacha hai tumhen zindagani duniya dhokay mein na dalay, aur na dhokay baaz shetan tumhen ghaflat mein dalay
Yaad rakho! shetan tumhara dushman hai, tum ussay dushman jano woh to apney giroh ko sirf uss liye hi bulata hai kay woh sab jahannum o asal ho jayen
Jo log kafir huye unn kay liye sakht saza hai aur jo log eman laye aur nek aemaal kiye unn kay liye bakhsish hai aur (boht) bara ajar hai

Kiya pus woh shakhs jiss kay liye uss kay buray aemaal muzayyan kerdiye gaye hain pus woh unhen samajhta hai (kiya woh hidayat yafta shakhs jaisa hai), (yaqeen mano) kay Allah jissay chahaye gumrah kerta hai aur jissay chahaye raah raast dikhata hai. Pus aap ko unn per ghum kha kha ker apni jaan halakat mein na daalni chahaye, yeh jo kuch ker rahey hain uss say yaqeenan Allah Taalaa bakhoobi waqif hai

Aur Allah hi hawayen chalata hai jo badlon ko uthati hain phir hum badlon ko khushk zamin ki taraf ley jatay hain aur uss say uss zamin ko uss ki maut kay baad zindah ker detay hain. Ussi tarah doobara ji uthna (bhi) hai

Jo shakhs izzat hasil kerna chahata ho to Allah Taalaa hi ki sari izzat hai, tamam tar suthray kalmaat ussi ki taraf charhtay hain aur nek amal unn ko buland kerta hai, jo log buraiyon kay daaon ghaat mein lagay rehtay hain unn kay liye sakht tar azab hai, aur unn ka yeh makar barbaad hojaye ga

Logo! Allah Taalaa ney tumhen mitti say phir nutfay say peda kiya hai, phir tumhen joray joray (mard o aurat) bana diya hai, aurton ko hamila hona aur bachon ka tawallud hona sab uss kay ilm say hi hai, aur jo bari umar wala umar diya jaye aur jiss ki umar ghatay woh sab kitab mein likha hua hai. Allah Taalaa per yeh baat bilkul aasan hai

Aur barabar nahi do darya yeh meetha hai piyas bujhata peenay mein khusgawar aur yeh doosra khaari hai kerwa, tum unn dono mein say taza gosht khatay ho aur woh zewraat nikaltay ho jinhen tum pehantay ho. Aur aap dekhtay hain kay bari bari kashtiyan pani ko cheerney phaarney wali unn daryaon mein hain takay tum uss ka fazal dhondo aur takay tum uss ka shukar kero

Woh raat ko din aur din ko raat mein dakhil kerta hai aur aftab mahtab ko ussi ney kaam mein laga diya hai. Her aik miyad moyyen per chal raha hai. Yehi hai Allah tum sab ka paalney wala ussi ki saltanat hai. Jinhen tum uss kay siwa pukar rahey ho woh to khajoor ki guthli kay chilkay kay bhi malik nahi

Agar tum unhen pukaro to woh tumhari pukar suntay hi nahi aur agar (bil-farz) sunn bhi len to faryad rasi nahi keren gay, balkay)yeh qayamat kay din tumharay uss shirk ka saaf inkar ker jayen gay. Aap ko koi haq Taalaa jaisa khabardaar khabren na dey ga
Aey logo! tum Allah kay mohtaj ho aur Allah bey-niaz khoobiyon wala hai
Agar woh chahaye to tum ko fana kerdey aur aik naee makhlooq peda kerdey
Aur yeh baat Allah ko kuch mushkil nahi

Koi bhi bojh uthaney wala doosray ka bojh nahi uthaye ga, agar koi giran baar doosray ko apna bojh uthaney kay liye bulaye ga to woh uss mein say kuch bhi na uthaye ga go qarabat daar hi ho. To sirf unn hi ko aagah sakta hai jo ghaeebana tor per apney rab say dartay hain aur namazon ki pabandi kertay hain aur jo bhi pak hojaye woh apney hi nafa kay liye pak hoga. Lotna Allah hi ki taraf hai
Aur andha aur aankhon wala barabar nahi
Aur na tareeki aur roshni
Aur na chaaon aur na dhoop
Aur zindah aur murday barabar nahi hosaktay, Allah Taalaa jiss ko chahata hai suna deta hai, aur aap unn logon ko nahi suna saktay jo qabron mein hain
Aap to sirf daraney walay hain
Hum ney hi aap ko haq dey ker khushkhabri sunaney wala aur darr sunaney wala bana ker bheja hai aur koi ummat aisi nahi hui jiss mein koi darr sunaney wala na guzra ho
Aur agar yeh log aap ko jhutla den to jo log unn say pehlay ho guzray hain unhon ney bhi jhutlaya tha unn kay pass bhi unn kay payghumbar moajzzay aur saheefay aur roshan kitaben ley ker aaye thay
Phir mein unn kafiron ko pakar liya so mera azab kaisa hua

Kiya aap ney uss baat per nazar nahi ki kay Allah Taalaa ney aasman say pani utara phir hum ney uss kay zariye say mukhtalif rangaton kay phal nikalay aur paharon kay mukhtalif hissay hain safaid aur surkh kay unn ki bhi rangaten mukhtalif hain aur boht gehray siyah

Aur ussi tarah aadmiyon aur janwaron aur chopayon mein bhi baaz aisay hain kay unn ki rangaten mukhtalif hain, Allah say uss kay o hi banday dartay hain jo ilm rakhtay hain waqaee Allah Taalaa zabardast bara bakhshney wala hai

Jo log kitab Allah ki tilawat kertay hain aur namaz ki pabandi rakhtay hain aur jo kuch hum ney unn ko ata farmaya hai uss mein say posheedah aur aelaaniya kharach kertay hain woh aisi tijarat kay umeedwaar hain jo kabhi khasarah mein na hogi
Takay unn ko unn ki ujraten poori dey aur unn ko apney fazal say aur ziyadah dey be-shak woh bara bakhshney wala qadardaan hai

Aur yeh kitab jo hum ney aap kay pass wahee kay tor per bheji hai yeh bilkul theek hai jo kay apney say pehli kitabon ki bhi tasdeeq kerti hai. Allah Taalaa apney bandon ki poori khabar rakhney wala khoob dekhney wala hai

Phir hum ney unn logon ko (uss) kitab ka waris banaya jin ko hum ney apney bandon mein say pasand farmaya. Phir baazay to unn mein apni janon per zulm kerney walay hain aur baazay unn mein mutawassit darjay kay hain aur baazay unn mein Allah ki tofiq say nekiyon mein taraqqi kiye chalay jatay hain. Yeh bara fazal hai
Woh baghaat mein hamesha rehney kay jin mein yeh log dakhil hun gay soney kay kanggan aur moti pehnaye jawen gay. Aur poshak unn ki o haan resham ki hogi
Aur kahen gay kay Allah ka lakh lakh shukar hai jiss ney hum say ghum door kiya. Be-shak humara perwerdigar bara bakhshney wala bara qadardaan hai
Jiss ney hum ko apney fazal say hamesha rehney kay muqam mein laa utara jahan na hum ko koi takleef phonchay gi aur na hum ko koi khastagi phonchay gi
Aur jo log kafir hain unn kay liye dozakh ki aag hai na to unn ki qaza hi aaye gi kay marr hi jayen aur na dozakh ka azab hi unn say halka kiya jaye ga. Hum her kafir ko aisi hi saza detay hain

Aur woh log uss mein chillayen gay kay aey humaray perwerdigar! hum ko nikal ley hum achay kaam keren gay bar-khilaf unn kaamon kay jo kiya kertay thay, (Allah kahey ga) kiya hum ney tum ko itni umar na di thi kay jiss ko samajhna hota woh samajh sakta aur tumharay pass daraney wala bhi phoncha tha, so maza chakho kay (aisay) zalimon ka koi madadgar nahi
Be-shak Allah Taalaa jannay wala hai aasmano aur zamin ki posheedah cheezon ka, be-shak o hi jannay wala hai seenon ki baaton ka

O hi aisa hai jiss ney tum ko zamin mein abad kiya, so jo shakhs kufur keray ga uss kay kufur ka wabaal ussi per paray ga. Aur kafiron kay liye unn ka kufur unn kay perwerdigar kay nazdeek narazi hi barhney ka baees hota hai, aur kafiron kay liye unn ka kufur khasarah hi barhney ka baees hota hai

Aap kahiye! kay tum apney qarardaad shareekon ka haal to batlao jin ko tum Allah kay siwa pooja kertay ho. Yani mujh ko yeh batlao kay unhon ney zamin mein say kaun sa (juzzv) banaya hai ya unn ka aasmano mein kuch sajha hai ya hum ney unn ko koi kitab di hai kay yeh uss ki daleel per qaeem hun, balkay)yeh yeh zalim aik doosray say niray dhokay ki baaton ka wada kertay aatay hain
Yaqeeni baat hai kay Allah Taalaa aasmano aur zamin ko thamay huye hai kay woh tal na jayen aur agar woh tal jayen to phir Allah kay siwa aur koi unn ko thaam bhi nahi sakta. Woh haleem ghafoor hai

Aur unn kuffaar ney bari zordar qasam khaee thi kay agar unn kay pass koi daraney wala aaye to woh her aik ummat say ziyadah hidayat qabool kerney walay hun. Phir jab unn kay pass aik payghumbar aa phonchay to bus unn ki nafrat hi mein izafa hua

Duniya mein apney ko bara samajhney ki wajah say, aur unn ki buri tadbeeron ki wajah say aur buri tadbeeron ka wabaal unn tadbeer walon hi per parta hai, so kiya yeh ussi dastoor kay muntazir hain jo aglay logon kay sath hota raha hai. So aap Allah kay dastoor ko kabhi badalta hua na payen gay, aur aap Allah kay dastoor ko kabhi muntaqil hota hua na payen gay

Aur kiya yeh log zamin mein chalay phiray nahi jiss mein dekhtay bhaltay kay jo log unn say pehlay ho guzray hain unn ka anjam kiya hua? Halankay woh qooat mein unn say barhay huye thay, aur Allah aisa nahi hai kay koi cheez uss ko hara dey na aasmano mein aur na zamin mein. Woh baray ilm wala, bari qudrat wala hai

Aur agar Allah Taalaa logon per unn kay aemaal kay sabab darogeer farmaney lagta to aur zamin per aik jaandaar ko na chorta, lekin Allah Taalaa unn ko aik miyad moyyen tak mohlat dey raha hai, so jab unn ki woh miyad phonchay gi Allah Taalaa apney bandon ko aap dekh ley ga
